title: 9 Things a Godly Man Says No To Before Noon
caption:
Losing to your alarm is losing before the day starts. Whoever gets your first ten minutes gets more than you think.

Self-control shows up in the rooms nobody's grading. The second bowl. The reply he'd regret by lunch. The scroll that was supposed to be five minutes and never is.

His highlight reel was never your assignment. Integrity is what you do when nobody's likely to check.

Nine small no's before noon. None of them look like discipline in the moment. All of them are.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #selfcontrol #discipline
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
